name: How can I make my small bathroom feel larger during a remodel?
description: To make a small bathroom feel larger, use light colors, large tiles, wall-mounted vanities, frameless glass showers, good lighting, and large mirrors.

mainEntity.name: How can I make my small bathroom feel larger during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: To make a small bathroom feel larger, consider using light color palettes, installing large format tiles to minimize grout lines, and choosing a wall-mounted vanity to free up floor space. Incorporating a frameless glass shower enclosure instead of a bulky shower curtain can also create an open feel. Good lighting, large mirrors, and strategic storage solutions will further enhance the perception of space.
